finding: LibreCAD's bundled DXF DIMASSOC reader and writer swapped group 70 trans-space and group 71 rotated-dimension type. The upstream libdxfrw implementation already used the documented mapping.
change: Correct the bundled reader and writer mapping, correct the group-71 byte-overflow test, and make the osnap tests exercise either bounded typed readback or refusal according to the library's modeled fields.
verification: The new asymmetric group-70=1/group-71=0 reader test failed on the bundled fork before the mapping fix, then passed afterwards.
Both linked libraries pass four DIMASSOC cases: 42 assertions with the corrected bundled fork and 48 with upstream. The field test checks actual ASCII and Binary writer tags and typed readback.
The combined DIMASSOC/MPOLYGON selector passes 12/12 cases with the corrected bundled fork and 10/12 upstream; the upstream failures are the two geometry cases (152/161 assertions pass).
The patch passes forward and reverse apply checks against its stated parent and commit.
limits: The downstream change is local and unmerged and has not been checked against a newer LibreCAD head.
The osnap capability distinction does not claim complete native DIMASSOC semantics or graph closure.
No DWG or DXF fixture files were added.
